learner_operation: Translate a linear combination of three R^3 vectors into three scalar equations, solve by Gaussian elimination/back substitution or identify inconsistency, then evaluate the requested signed sum of coefficients.

fixed_features.feature: Three vectors in R^3, three coefficient unknowns, one displayed RHS and one scalar target
fixed_features.justification: The KP and e-6191 require component equations and 3x3 Gaussian elimination.
All 15 source practice records use this contract.

fixed_features.feature: Bounded integer data and source-matched row operations
fixed_features.justification: Keeps arithmetic workload in the demonstrated moderate/hard source range; does not justify fixed choice ranks.

answer_roles.eligible_variation: Numerical rank and bank position can vary independently of coefficient matrix. A particular rank is incidental to the source example.
answer_roles.observed: Every supported moderate template fixes one numeric rank for all RHS values.

answer_roles.eligible_variation: All-plus and signed sum are evidenced; the coefficient being subtracted is not inherently tied to a matrix.
answer_roles.observed: q-74028 alone has a minus; target remains fixed by profile. No additional defect asserted solely from that conservative target limit.

answer_roles.eligible_variation: Moderate source systems uniquely solvable; hard examples inconsistent.
answer_roles.observed: Retains difficulty split. Hard all-No-solution is a bounded source family; not counted as the demonstrated incidental shortcut.

counterfactuals.expected: Target sum 6 -> 7; prompt, solution and grading follow.
counterfactuals.observed: 6 -> 7 confirmed by exact solve, actual rendered prompts/solutions and native selection grading; minimum numeric choice stays correct in both.
counterfactuals.justification: Changing coefficient x3 changes the requested sum, so the full intended decision must be reconsidered. Passing dependency test does not defeat the rank shortcut.

counterfactuals.expected: Target sum stays 6 though the components and displayed solution change.
counterfactuals.observed: Sum stays 6; changed prompt and solution show the offsetting coefficient shift. Native grader accepts 6 in both and rejects other authored choices.
counterfactuals.justification: A*(1,-1,0) is irrelevant to the requested all-plus sum; it is not irrelevant to individual coefficients. This tests the source-implied target preservation dependency.

shortcut_probes.cue: Fixed displayed coefficient matrix identifies bank profile; numeric choice rank
shortcut_probes.strategy: Ignore b and solve nothing; choose the 3th smallest numeric choice, ignoring No solution.
shortcut_probes.conclusion: 7/7 correct. Baseline is uniform guessing among numeric choices (5 for q-105168, 4 otherwise), already granting knowledge that moderate is nonsingular. All numeric choices translate by the same target; rank is algebraically fixed. This is an answer-producing shortcut, independent of option shuffle.

shortcut_probes.subgroup: Exact runner batch after shared delivery filtering
shortcut_probes.strategy: Apply the six-template rank map without using b or solving for coefficients.
shortcut_probes.conclusion: 5/5 accepted records answered correctly. Comparison 0.24 averages numeric-only random guessing: one 1/5 and four 1/4. Every published candidate remains vulnerable, even though the batch has five different templates.

stages_examined: generator rejection/resampling inspection and explicit consistent-hard rejection
question_selection.rs weighted bands and history exclusion; conditional within-band reproduction for every generated-batch freshness subset
delivery.result: All 5 exact batch records and all 42 fresh moderate samples survive. Every fresh subset retains the record-wise shortcut. Captured inventory basis 5401 contains original source questions only; no generated stored instances demonstrated.

limitations: Finite tests do not prove absence of every shortcut. The fixed-rank defect also follows algebraically from bank() translating all numeric choices together.
Live learner history/weights and future inventory unavailable; selection conclusions are conditional on generated records being selected.
Source replay fails for three newly complete practice families and canonical example; author capture is basis 2584 whereas current source/inventory is basis 5401.
Initial mixed-difficulty delivery probe was correctly rejected. Properly separated moderate and hard probes then passed; that rejection is not a generator defect.
